{"subject":"Quillstack's January GitHub update","body":"Hi,

I noticed that in January the Quillstack GitHub listed @priya-k as maintainer and CTO. Having a named technical lead on the repo is a meaningful signal, and I wanted to say congratulations.

I'd enjoy hearing how the team and the product are shaping up. If useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call at whatever time works for you. Just reply with a couple of slots.

Best,
Marcus"}
